payload.posture: Read Revelation 22:1–5 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the final vision shows the river, tree of life, healed nations, abolished curse, divine service, unveiled face, and unending light. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
